newsitem.title: USA: Peerless to buy back up to 200,000 shrs.
newsitem.headline: Peerless to buy back up to 200,000 shrs.

text.p: Peerless Group Inc said Wednesday that it will repurchase up to 200,000 shares of its outstanding common stock.
The company said it will buy the share at prevailing market prices during a maximum period of 90 days ending September 14, when the company will decide whether to continue it.

The company added that it plans to conduct the purchases through open market transactions unless opportunities arise for unsolicited negotiated transactions or other types of repurchases. No shares, it said, will be repurchased directly from its directors or officers.
Peerless has about 4.7 million shares outstanding.
The company designs, develops, installs and supports integrated information systems for community banks and credit unions nationwide.
